When ReactDOMForm-test.js is run by the repository's Jest setup, the newly added focused case excludes the file's ordinary sibling tests from that run.
The change adds `it.only`, and repository evidence explicitly identifies `.only` as the mechanism for focusing a test. The focused-test helper delegates to `test.only`, while the ESLint rule that would reject focused tests is disabled. Thus this is not merely an ordinary added test: it selects the new case over non-focused sibling cases in ReactDOMForm-test.js.
Impact: Caused by the change: The changed line introduces the only focused marker in this file. The repository uses `.only` to focus tests and does not enable its no-focused-tests lint rule, so this new marker causes Jest to select this case rather than the file's ordinary `it` cases, reducing execution of the form regression suite.
